name: Perry Cooking American Hamburger
summary: Set the grill up for a nice recipe in this Perry hamburger cooking game as he is hungry and cannot do any of his detective work on an empty stomach. Surely you will help him in the kitchen because he really loves some company. He is a platypus and he has grown to like the food that us people consume so now he wants to make something really delicious. cut the bun in half and then start adding in the toppings. Do not forget that the patty is the most important piece and with some cheese on top it will be a delicious meal for a smart detective in this agent P cooking game.
